protocol.selection: All validation records; pair(random.Random(record.id)); sorted source then id
protocol.candidates: All same-source validation targets, including duplicate targets
protocol.positives: Exact training positive_mask; normalized answers or overlapping image/caption keys
protocol.ties: First candidate in record-id order, exactly as training validation
protocol.types: Question/source-only heuristic v1; not official question-type annotation

reconstruction.limitation: Original step-0 checkpoint was overwritten. Same seed/constructor reconstruction cannot be certified bit-identical without an original hash. CPU/GPU loading can consume different RNG.

basis: Written text, numbers and quantitative evidence
feature_provenance.supervision: one fixed pair per image, random.Random(record id), no test selection

limitation: Reconstructed initial head, NOT original saved Step 0. CPU float32 features; training validation is CUDA bfloat16. Do not present as a precision-controlled causal training delta.
